meta.title: Ambient Gallery (dsh-ambient-gallery)
meta.description: A string of photographs hung behind the main panel — each a different size at its own angle, all with room to breathe, kept to the middle 20-80% of the width. Twenty real landscape photographs ship with the plugin and are pinned onto the wall on first run; every frame rotates up to twenty images, the three lowest frames accept a local video, and one shortcut sends the video back into the rotation.
